title: Data-leakage audit and external-data test

checks.evidence: No run paths cross splits, but all 102 logical class/attack/level/NPC scenario keys recur in all three seeds. Noise subset repeats all 12 of its scenario keys. Seed 3 is a replicate split, not unseen-scenario generalization.
306 within-scenario seed-pair comparisons across 23 physical IMU/odometry fields; median pairwise median column correlation is low; no exact sensor rows or correlations >=0.99.
No direct time/ID/label/path feature names. Found per-run constants, small label-dependent startup missingness, and two cumulative collector counters that are constant zero.
Saved model imputer/scaler statistics match seed-1/2 recomputation to floating-point tolerance; training code fits only seeds 1-2.

Hash set and publisher/subscriber counts match training-only provenance, but rule gap/lag/late limits match all-normal seed1-3 data. A seed1-2-only sensitivity changes seed3 rule false alerts from 58 (41.115/h) to 52 (36.861/h).
Model thresholds/hyperparameters are chosen on seed 1/2 only, but the checked-in inventory rule limits were estimated from seed-3 normal telemetry; this is test-informed policy tuning.

Training features are causal and constructed per run. In monitor continuous mode, _ordered_slices returns one frame across manifest joins, so differences/rolling windows can span segments unless reset_at_joins is enabled.
With fixed random 0-20 s cuts, selected noise recall stayed 9/9; selected telemetry-model recall stayed 36/99, with per-class results recorded below. No evidence of an absolute-start-time shortcut.

Event recall remained high after within-run shuffling, but the validation-selected thresholds flagged 74.1% of noise rows and 97.5% of security rows; precision was near test prevalence and false alerts exploded. The test is inconclusive, not proof of feature leakage.
Paths/run IDs are used for file loading or alert metadata only; model features drop time/labels and monitor strips identity columns before scoring.
No external_data/ folder or external CSV was supplied; no external metrics were fabricated.

near_duplicate_analysis.comparison_definition: For each class/attack, level and NPC scenario, align rows by row position to the common length; compute Pearson correlation per physical IMU/odometry raw column, then median across columns. Age and stamp-lag metadata are excluded. Exact row fraction requires all 23 corresponding values to match exactly (NaNs compare equal).

hashes.result: approved values equal training-only hash set; seed 3 added no new hash

domain_ids.provenance: bootstrap iterates every indexed manifest, but seed 3 adds no new domain id

seed3_scoring_effect.note: temporary training-only inventory sensitivity; shipped inventory and rules were not changed

inventory_provenance_and_effect.source_note: bootstrap_inventory reads every normal row and every indexed manifest; current checked-in values were compared against seed-1/2-only recomputation.

tuning_audit.noise_model: candidate fitting and preliminary imputer use seed 1; validation/model and threshold selection seed 2; final models fit seeds 1-2; held-out evaluation seed 3.
tuning_audit.security_model: training loads seeds {1,2}; fit seed1, threshold selection seed2, final fit seeds1-2; evaluation loads seed3.
tuning_audit.code_and_report_search: No code/report matches found for seed-3 threshold/selection/tuning. Seed-3 mentions were evaluation-only. Exception: inventory bootstrap uses all seeds for policy quantiles as described above.
tuning_audit.hyperparameters: fixed in the source model builders; random_state=42; no seed3 selection detected.

causality_and_identity.noise_features: only current/past values; time differences divide value differences; rolling standard deviation is trailing 25 rows (0.5 s), min_periods=5.
causality_and_identity.security_features: label/time columns excluded; node hash contributes only a row-to-row changed flag; rolling window is trailing 5 telemetry rows.
causality_and_identity.training_run_boundaries: feature functions invoked on each run independently.
causality_and_identity.monitor_join_behavior: reset_at_joins=True slices segments; default continuous mode does not split at joins and may carry rolling/difference state across segments.
causality_and_identity.inference_identity: relative_path, run_id, seed and class are excluded from monitor feature frames; agent metadata is returned separately and does not enter model score.

external_test.adapter: src/ziaxen_agent/external_adapter.py; returns a 50 Hz frame and mapping details, and writes mapping JSON when mapping_path is passed.
external_test.not_applicable_rule: If more than half the expected raw model sensor columns are missing after direct mapping/derivation, the adaptation is marked not applicable; do not score it.
external_test.security_model: Not testable on public sensor CSVs without Ziaxen ROS graph telemetry; no mapping is invented.
external_test.transfer_caveat: Any future external results are transfer estimates, not proof of real-world performance.
external_test.true_test_requirements: Owned ROS 2 robot/vehicle recordings with written approval, realistic sensor noise, a ROS-driven controller, and the same telemetry collector.

part_c_prior_fixes.status: already present and re-verified in this checkout
part_c_prior_fixes.missing_input_coverage_tests: present; includes separate missing aligned/telemetry CLI coverage assertions

verdict: Leakage was found: the checked-in ROS policy limits use seed-3 normal telemetry, and the same scenario definitions recur in the held-out seed. The two fitted ML models and their imputers/scalers do not use seed 3. Near-duplicate trajectory checks did not find copied runs. Startup missingness and constant/cumulative inputs are small or non-informative; continuous joined-stream inference can span segments. The shuffled-label event metric is inconclusive because the selected threshold saturates alerts.
